subject: feat: add Cloud Refresh — exec-action-based autonomous token refresh
body:
When enabled, Buddy creates a Mnemosyne exec-action that refreshes the build-cli
Cognito token on a 45-min schedule, keeping servers authenticated even when the
Mac is asleep or Buddy isn't running.

- Config: execAction + cloudRefreshEnabled fields in MnemosyneConfig
- MnemosyneManager: fetchCloudRefreshScript (fetches admin-owned script body),
  createExecAction, patchExecActionFields
- AppState: enableCloudRefresh (reads build-cli refresh_token from Keychain,
  detects region from JWT iss claim, fetches script, creates exec-action),
  disableCloudRefresh (revokes exec-action), checkBuildCliRefreshTokenRotation
  (patches exec-action fields when Cognito issues a new refresh_token)
- Push loop: skips Mnemosyne token push when cloudRefreshEnabled; wakes every
  10 min instead to detect refresh_token rotation
- MenuBarView: Cloud Refresh toggle above Encrypt toggle in Smart Link ok state

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>

  instead of a local store-action PATCH
- Staleness detection in push loop: if token iat > 60 min old, exec-action is
  considered stalled — logs the error, sends a macOS notification, falls back to
  a local PATCH, and shows a red status with a descriptive message
